summary: ResumeMatch AI end-to-end verification (backend + frontend). 17/17 pytest cases passed. Full UI flow driven from real preview URL: signup, login (wrong+right), upload PDF, analyze via real GPT 5.4 LLM (ATS=83, breakdowns kw=81/sk=84/ex=85, gap+missing+improvements populated), Optimize via real LLM (optimized_resume length=2066 chars, contains SUMMARY/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE headers, predicted score returned), copy button visible, Download PDF (3141 bytes, starts with %PDF magic), History list/open/delete, and logout redirect to /login all work. AI feature evidence: analyze - ats_score:83, breakdown ints in range; optimize - resume-shaped text >2KB with section headers. No LLM errors in backend log during the test window. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: routes are clean; JWT and dependency injection correct; `_id` excluded on projected reads.
resume_parser.py: pdfplumber + python-docx handle both file types; fallback to raw decode is fine.
ai_service.py: _extract_json is robust (handles code fences + brace scan). LLM prompts return schema strictly. Good.
pdf_generator.py: reportlab layout is ATS-friendly, no images/tables. Escaping present.
auth.py: bcrypt + JWT solid; email lowercased on register/login/me consistently.
AuthContext.jsx: token/user persisted; logout wipes state. Protected wrapper correctly redirects on user=null.
Dashboard.jsx: canAnalyze gate (uploaded && jobTitle && jobDesc>30) prevents useless calls; optimize auto-runs analyze if none exists.
ResultsDashboard.jsx: score ring + tabs behave; download uses responseType blob; copy uses navigator.clipboard (works in secure preview context).
Minor: AppHeader has a nested block-in-button (React hydration warning) — fix by using spans or shadcn `asChild` where appropriate.
Minor: Frontend does not surface backend `filename` when re-loading a past analysis if `original_resume_text` was not persisted before optimization ran (only stored after optimize). Acceptable.
test_credentials: Demo user in /app/memory/test_credentials.md works: test@resumematch.ai / testpass123
seed_data_creation: Sample PDF generated at /tmp/sample_resume.pdf (Jane Doe, Senior Frontend Engineer, 760 chars parsed). History rows created and cleaned up by TestHistory. TEST_ prefixed users created in TestAuth are harmless leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend REST is fully wired; use /api prefix and HTTPBearer. Run tests with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope, 2 workers). LLM path (GPT 5.4) via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is confirmed live — real JSON schemas returned in analyze/optimize. Do not include analyze+history in the same class expecting cross-worker state; TestHistory now seeds its own analysis.
